2001.notes: The archived PDF (38 pages) lacks the Film Descriptions section (printed pages 28-52) and PDF pages 3, 7 and 27 are empty or ads, so most films have no year, runtime, cast or synopsis; summaries are null wherever the programme gives no description. Films were assembled from the section lists (PDF pp. 8, 10-15), the Opening/Closing/Tribute pages (20-28), the Calendar (29-32), the Encore page (33) and the Index (37); shorts known only from the Index get page 37 and their parent programme from the Index's parenthesis. Screenings come from the multi-column Calendar, untangled by ticket codes (S=Sequoia, R=Rafael, O=OAC, M=Masonic, C=Pacific Cinema Corte Madera); they agree with the explicit dates on the VFest and Children's FilmFest pages. Three TBA calendar slots (Oct 9 9:30 PM Sequoia, Oct 10 9:00 PM Rafael, Oct 14 4:45 PM Rafael) were skipped. Films listed in several sections were given one section in this priority: Children's FilmFest, Five@Five, Valley of the Docs, New Media/VFest, Official Premiere Selection, World Cinema focus (Latin America / Iran), U.S. Cinema, World Cinema. Countries 'USA' for U.S. Cinema titles and 'Iran' for Migratory Goose are inferred from the section heading. The Mystic Masseur is 'India' in the World Cinema list but 'USA' in its own Opening Night entry (used). Lantana is 'Australia/Germany' in the list but 'Australia' in its entry (used). For shorts screened with a feature, shorts_program is the feature/programme name as in the Index. Double bills (Judy's Time / My Mother India, The Hotel Upstairs / The Landfill, The Disenchanted Forest / The Shaman's Apprentice) are kept as separate non-short records. 'Return to Sender' appears in both Sons Set in South Africa and Who Needs Love; kept as two records since it is unclear whether it is the same film. Five@Five short 'Elvis Doesn't Sing Here Anymore' is 'Elvis Doesn't Sing Anymore' in the Index. Director names kept as printed (e.g. 'Rakhshan Bani Elemad', 'Amir Ali Abdollah zadeh'). Invited guests (Michael Badalucco, Barbara Hershey, Anthony LaPaglia, Malcolm McDowell for encore screenings) are listed as guests. Seminar 'The Future of the Art Film' is 10AM-12NOON on its page but 11:00 in the Calendar (page time used); 'Animation: What's Up, Doc?' is misprinted 'Saturday October 3 5PM' on its page, Calendar shows Oct 13 3:00 (used). Kids Rock 'n' B-Roll and The Mo' Hi De Ho Show are compilation programmes with no individual titles printed. Encore screenings run after the festival (Oct 15-18). Tribute reception times differ slightly between the Special Events page (p.4) and the tribute pages; tribute pages used. No festival awards are printed in this programme.

2002.notes: Source is only the alphabetical film-notes section (printed pages 25-50) of the 2002 programme; front matter, schedule grid, Opening Night (printed p.18) and Closing Night (printed p.24) pages are not in this file, so festival date range, venue addresses (except Rafael Film Center), staff and festival awards are absent. Edition 25 taken from repeated '25th Anniversary' references. Screening dates fall Oct 3-13, 2002; Frida's opening-night and Merci Docteur Rey's closing-night screenings are not dated here, only their second screenings. Venue 'Cinema' is as printed (likely Century Cinema, not stated). Shorts programmes (Aardvark Adventures and Other Animania, Animarathon 2002, Animated Amigos, Cake Steak and Cheez Whiz, Even Oddfellows Get the Blues, the five Five@Five programmes, Heaven's Crossroad/Inside the Box, Human Rights and Inhuman Wrongs, The Northern De-Lights, A Scandinavian Salute, Two-by-Forman, Videosyncrasies 2002, We Are Family) are not film records themselves; each constituent film is, with shorts_program set and the programme's screenings copied; shorts shown before a feature have shorts_program = that feature's title. Constituent films of 40+ minutes in such programmes have is_short false. Runtimes printed as m:ss were truncated to whole minutes; 'Don't Let Your Friends Rot' and 'We're All Just People!' share a printed 2 min, runtime null. Shorts with no country printed take the programme country only when the programme is USA-only. Animated Amigos Oct 6 time printed '11:30PM' (probably 11:30AM), kept as printed; Just a Kiss Oct 3 time printed '9:45' without AM/PM. Farang Ba '(Crazy White Foreigner)' and Gagooman '(The Twilight)' parentheticals are English translations, not original titles, so original_title is null. Guests include 'Invited Guest' names. Guest name spellings normalised: 'Sarah Hanneman' -> Sarah Hannemann, 'Nicoloas Breviére' -> Nicolas Brevière, director 'Mahmound Ben Mahmound' -> Mahmoud Ben Mahmoud, 'Kairis̆s' -> Kairišs. These Are Not My Images year printed '2000/2001' so film_year null; Cake, Steak and Cheez Whiz printed 'USA 2001/2002'. Section 'Children's FilmFest' is assigned only to I Was a Rat (explicitly labelled); many other entries say 'Recommended for ages N and up' but no section is printed. Awards printed only as past honours (e.g. Golden Bear for Bloody Sunday, Camera d'Or) are not festival awards and were omitted. Reviewers are credited only by initial and surname, so no staff list was built. Independent Spirits also includes unnamed Hubley shorts; A Year Along the Abandoned Road has no director printed.

2023-saltburn.title: Saltburn
2023-saltburn.summary: Oscar® winner Emerald Fennell ( Promising Young Woman , MVFF43) proves herself a bright star of new British cinema with this wickedly funny mix of revenge comedy and erotic thriller starring Barry Keoghan ( The Banshees of Inisherin , MVFF45).

2023-the-9-lives-of-barbara-dane-perform.title: The 9 Lives of Barbara Dane • Performances with Special Guests including Holly Near and Willie Chambers
2023-the-9-lives-of-barbara-dane-perform.summary: A special one-of-a-kind tribute concert honoring the legendary Barbara Dane and the much-anticipated premiere of Maureen Gosling's captivating documentary, The 9 Lives of Barbara Dane .

2023-the-9-lives-of-barbara-dane.title: The 9 Lives of Barbara Dane
2023-the-9-lives-of-barbara-dane.summary: Maureen Gosling celebrates the life of singer Barbara Dane, a woman whose stellar voice supported justice movements in the Bay Area and beyond for decades, garnering an impressive FBI file along the way.

2023-bestiary.title: Bestiary
2023-bestiary.summary: A trio of mean girls chooses a new target for their vicious bullying, sparking intense rivalries and violent impulses that threaten to spin out of control.

2023-operation-frankenstein.title: Operation Frankenstein
2023-operation-frankenstein.summary: Three mischievous siblings discover part of a mannequin in a dumpster and see it as a perfect opportunity to build their very own Frankenstein monster.

2023-keynote-the-time-is-now-building-a-.title: Keynote: The Time Is Now: Building a New Film Ecosystem with Ted Hope
2023-keynote-the-time-is-now-building-a-.summary: Ted Hope will explain why the conditions are right for a total reboot of cinema and how we can all offer a hand, using all that we really know but somehow forgot or never properly respected.

2023-adrift.title: Adrift
2023-adrift.summary: Veteran filmmaker Rory Kennedy launches a welcome intervention into the ongoing global refugee crisis.

2023-panel-ai-perils-possibilities-promi.title: Panel: AI: Perils, Possibilities, Promises
2023-panel-ai-perils-possibilities-promi.summary: With this moderated conversation, our participants offer a diversity of perspectives on the ethics and creative potential of AI in film and media productions.

2023-david-s-doodles.title: David's Doodles
2023-david-s-doodles.summary: An autistic teenage cartoonist shares his work, his creative process, and his greatest weakness: drawing realistically.

2023-nyad.title: Nyad
2023-nyad.summary: The extraordinary true story of long-distance swimmer Diana Nyad’s (Annette Bening) attempt to swim from Cuba to Florida at the age of 64, with the support of her coach and longtime friend Bonnie Stoll (Jodie Foster).

2023-periodical.title: Periodical
2023-periodical.summary: With Gloria Steinem, Megan Rapinoe, and Naomi Watts adding star power, this eye-opening documentary explores the fascinating science, politics, and mystery of the menstrual cycle.

2023-musica.title: Música!
2023-musica.summary: Venerated Bay Area documentarians Rob Epstein and Jeffrey Friedman’s latest celebrates a unique partnership between US and Cuban musicians, as well as the rich sonic traditions and budding young performers it helps sustain.

2023-frybread-face-and-me.title: Frybread Face and Me
2023-frybread-face-and-me.summary: Produced by Taika Waititi, director Billy Luther’s tender and wistfully funny debut spins the coming-of-age tale of two Navajo cousins spending the summer of 1990 together at their grandmother’s reservation home.

2023-circle-of-donuts.title: Circle of Donuts
2023-circle-of-donuts.summary: Here we meet a Japanese immigrant who traveled across the world at a young age and paved a unique path to success.

2023-binary.title: binary.
2023-binary.summary: In this intimate look into the life of a young transgender person inspired by androgynous rockstars, a teen struggles to understand who they really are while facing conflict with those around them.

2023-farming-while-black.title: Farming While Black
2023-farming-while-black.summary: Mark Decena’s visually eloquent documentary celebrates the rich heritage of Black farmers through the experiences of three people who make their living off the land.

2023-an-evening-of-east-and-west-coast-r.title: An Evening of East and West Coast Renegade Radio featuring Taj Mahal and Jesse Colin Young
2023-an-evening-of-east-and-west-coast-r.summary: Following the California premiere of Jay Schlossberg’s documentary feature film Feast Your Ears: The Story of WHFS 102.3 , we're turning up the heat with a live concert celebrating iconic independent radio stations.

2023-new-moon.title: New Moon
2023-new-moon.summary: Young Jay Jay and his mother Edie embark on a magical journey to rediscover lost dreams and nurture new hopes.

2023-swimming-the-rock.title: Swimming The Rock
2023-swimming-the-rock.summary: A man overcomes his grief by swimming to shore from Alcatraz.

2023-shorts-viva-el-cine-infantil.title: Shorts: ¡Viva el cine infantil!
2023-shorts-viva-el-cine-infantil.summary: As part of MVFF’s ¡Viva el cine! programming, we invite families and younger viewers to join our annual celebration of Spanish-language and Latinx films with this festive collection of kid-centric animated and narrative shorts. Ages 6+

2023-telephone.title: Telephone
2023-telephone.summary: Activist screendance documentary celebrating audio description for dance which allows blind and visually impaired people to be included fully in the joy of artistic expression.

2023-evil-does-not-exist.title: Evil Does Not Exist
2023-evil-does-not-exist.summary: Oscar® winner Ryûsuke Hamaguchi ( Drive My Car , MVFF44) builds his beautifully evocative and unequivocally political film around the most pressing issues of our time: corporate greed vs. environmental protection, and centralized power vs. community control.

2023-i-am-hope.title: I Am Hope
2023-i-am-hope.summary: Through fascinating fly-on-the-wall footage and insightful interviews, director ShakaJamal chronicles the effort to create a yoga and mindfulness program for Oakland middle schools.

2023-between-earth-sky.title: Between Earth & Sky
2023-between-earth-sky.summary: Renowned ecologist Nalini Nadkarni must turn her research onto herself in order to understand the effects of disturbance and recovery throughout her life.

2023-companion.title: Companion
2023-companion.summary: A woman faces the reality that maybe her roommate needs different things in their relationship.

2023-for-her.title: For Her
2023-for-her.summary: An Iranian youth finds fierce loyalty and solidarity among her two closest friends.

2023-mind-the-gap-summit.title: MIND THE GAP SUMMIT
2023-mind-the-gap-summit.summary: Join us as we celebrate the incredible work of female filmmakers, nonbinary filmmakers, trans filmmakers, and other marginalized filmmakers from around the world.

2023-burnout.title: Burnout
2023-burnout.summary: A clever mix of animation, music, and poetic narration illustrates the childlike creativity that fuels our ideas, and how quickly that can sour if expended in large bursts too fast.

2023-with-a-wool-ball.title: With a Wool Ball
2023-with-a-wool-ball.summary: In this stop-motion animation made from wool, a girl from the northwestern hills of Argentina spends the cold winters in a hut, knitting ponchos made of wool for her friends, the native animals that live around her.

2023-if-only-i-could-hibernate.title: If Only I Could Hibernate
2023-if-only-i-could-hibernate.summary: With warmth and empathy, this sensitive debut tells the moving story of a teenage physics prodigy juggling familial and academic responsibilities in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

2023-mountain-man.title: Mountain Man
2023-mountain-man.summary: In this sharp animation, a mountain man battles an antagonist made of stone amidst a harsh winter landscape. Good thing he’s a skilled skier.

2023-shorts-monsters-movies-the-moon.title: Shorts: Monsters, Movies & the Moon
2023-shorts-monsters-movies-the-moon.summary: Take a wild ride from Oakland to Zimbabwe in this fun and fanciful collection of stories filled with crazy monsters, classic movies, and enchanting trips to the moon.

2023-goodbye-julia.title: Goodbye Julia
2023-goodbye-julia.summary: In this powerful drama set against the 2011 split of Sudan, a fragile friendship develops between two women despite differences in religion and social standing. However, there are buried deceptions at play.

2023-patrol.title: Patrol
2023-patrol.summary: Illegal cattle ranching poses an existential threat to one of the most biodiverse regions in Central America. This stirring documentary follows the Rama-Kriol peoples' efforts to save this precious ecosystem before it’s too late.

2023-the-pinata.title: The Piñata
2023-the-pinata.summary: Seven-year-old Lorena is determined to win the school's piñata contest and its coveted grand prize: a new bicycle.

2023-filmmaker-party-community-mixer.title: FILMMAKER PARTY • COMMUNITY MIXER
2023-filmmaker-party-community-mixer.summary: Join us for an exciting gathering of filmmakers and film lovers from the Bay Area and beyond!

2023-la-chimera.title: La Chimera
2023-la-chimera.summary: From Alice Rohrwacher ( Le Pupille , MVFF45), a marvelous fantasy-comedy on the themes of love, loss, and Etruscan antiquities set in 1980s Tuscany, with The Crown 's Josh O’Connor terrific as an archaeological scholar-turned-artifact robber.

2023-another-body.title: Another Body
2023-another-body.summary: Some guys take rejection and compose beautiful love songs; others make deepfake revenge porn. Turns out both are perfectly legal and potentially profitable. In this eye-opening doc, a woman seeks justice.

2023-under-the-same-sky.title: Under the Same Sky
2023-under-the-same-sky.summary: Andrea and Marina become fast friends while playing on the rooftops of their adjacent buildings during the pandemic in Mexico City.

2023-farther.title: Farther
2023-farther.summary: A father faces some difficult truths when he revisits the past with his daughter.

2023-totem.title: Totem
2023-totem.summary: Lila Avilés’ impressionistic drama observes the intimacies of a sprawling middle-class family in crisis through the eyes of a child.

2023-society-of-the-snow.title: Society of the Snow
2023-society-of-the-snow.summary: Based on Pablo Vierci’s book about the astonishing true story of the 1972 Uruguayan Andes air disaster, this gripping thriller from J.A. Bayona relates the survivors’ struggle to endure for 72 days without food or shelter.

2023-the-boy-and-the-heron.title: The Boy and the Heron
2023-the-boy-and-the-heron.original_title: 君たちはどう生きるか
2023-the-boy-and-the-heron.summary: Legendary director Hayao Miyazaki’s new animated spectacular is another dizzying fantasy adventure as a Japanese boy, haunted by his past, discovers a strange alternate universe and the role he must play there.

2023-la-calesita.title: La Calesita
2023-la-calesita.summary: An animated tribute to the beloved Argentinian merry-go-round operators who have dedicated their lives to providing fun and happiness to children and their communities.

2023-the-right-to-read.title: The Right To Read
2023-the-right-to-read.summary: Executive produced by LeVar Burton, Jenny Mackenzie’s inspiring doc introduces us to several Bay Area residents taking action to reverse the disturbing trend of plummeting literacy — and give our children a brighter future full of appreciation for the written word.

2023-the-nature-of-love.title: The Nature of Love
2023-the-nature-of-love.summary: Sophia, 40, is lively, erudite, and bored. When sent by her long-time partner to supervise renovations at their country chalet, she meets Sylvain, and their erotic coup de foudre threatens to scorch all within range.

2023-maestro.title: Maestro
2023-maestro.summary: Bradley Cooper and Carey Mulligan deliver stunning performances as Leonard Bernstein and his wife, actress Felicia Montealegre, in this intimate dramatic portrait of their marriage and a career that made him an indispensable figure in the history of classical music. Along with his extraordinary portrayal, Cooper directs and co-wrote the script.

2023-passing-spaceships-an-earthly-conve.title: PASSING SPACESHIPS: AN EARTHLY CONVERSATION WITH BOOTS RILEY AND SEPHORA WOLDU
2023-passing-spaceships-an-earthly-conve.summary: Join us for a casual gathering with Boots and Sephora on unorthodox storytelling, indie filmmaking, and how fellow filmmakers can be your north star.

2023-sirocco-and-the-kingdom-of-the-wind.title: Sirocco and the Kingdom of the Winds
2023-sirocco-and-the-kingdom-of-the-wind.original_title: Sirocco et le royaume des courants d'air
2023-sirocco-and-the-kingdom-of-the-wind.summary: Kids become kitties in this surreal yet serene animated French tale of two little girls stuck in the fantasy world of their favorite children’s books.

2023-weirdos.title: Weirdos
2023-weirdos.summary: Could Jasmine and her middle-school frenemies be humanity’s best chance at stopping a monster invasion?

2023-the-teachers-lounge.title: The Teachers' Lounge
2023-the-teachers-lounge.summary: This gripping drama examines racism and institutional bureaucracy, putting you through an emotional and moral wringer as a well-meaning middle-school teacher makes a split-second decision that brings her idealism crashing down.

2023-for-the-skeptical.title: For the Skeptical
2023-for-the-skeptical.summary: Filmmaker Dawn Westlake asks us to stop autocracy in its tracks, with facts. Because despite the cultural and economic shifts, one thing will always matter: the truth.

2023-el-mono.title: El Moño
2023-el-mono.summary: After her favorite sock goes missing, Andrea learns some family magic that helps her find lost objects in the most unexpected way.

2023-my-sisters-in-the-stars-the-story-o.title: My Sisters In The Stars: The Story of Lee Yong-soo
2023-my-sisters-in-the-stars-the-story-o.summary: This powerful documentary chronicles the painful history and current activism of a former Korean “comfort woman” who was abducted at age 14 by the Japanese Army during WWII and forced into sexual slavery.

2023-invisible-nation.title: Invisible Nation
2023-invisible-nation.summary: Vanessa Hope’s arresting documentary examines Taiwan’s — and democracy’s — urgent fight for survival.

2023-clownin.title: Clownin'
2023-clownin.summary: It’s hard out there for a clown—and even harder for those aspiring to become one.

2023-one-with-the-whale.title: One With The Whale
2023-one-with-the-whale.summary: Modern technology confronts ancient ritual in this profound and heartwarming documentary about a Siberian Yupik community's way of life.

2023-the-crime-is-mine.title: The Crime is Mine
2023-the-crime-is-mine.summary: In 1930s Paris, two young women become embroiled in a murder case, turning its scandalous headlines to their mutual advantage. Director François Ozon’s latest is an ode to vintage screwball comedy, with an extravagantly outrageous Isabelle Huppert.

2023-the-bikeriders.title: The Bikeriders
2023-the-bikeriders.summary: Anchored by phenomenal performances from Jodie Comer, Tom Hardy, and Austin Butler, this latest from indie auteur Jeff Nichols ( Loving , MVFF39) chronicles a fictional biker gang in the mid-’60s Chicago.

2023-the-disappearance-of-shere-hite.title: The Disappearance of Shere Hite
2023-the-disappearance-of-shere-hite.summary: This beautifully crafted documentary profiles sexologist Shere Hite, a hardworking history student destined to make history, who revolutionized the cultural conversation about sex.

2023-the-hypnosis.title: The Hypnosis
2023-the-hypnosis.summary: An aspiring entrepreneur and his girlfriend attend a seminar to pitch their new app, not realizing her recent hypnotherapy has severed her inhibitions. An excruciatingly funny cringe comedy, it’s also a touching love story about truly seeing your partner for the first time.

2023-demon-mineral.title: Demon Mineral
2023-demon-mineral.summary: Hadley Austin’s fascinating documentary offers a penetrating look at the effects of radiation poisoning on Navajo land after decades of uranium mining.

2023-common-ground.title: Common Ground
2023-common-ground.summary: This dramatic doc focuses on the power of regenerative agriculture to transform the Earth, and how innovative farmers are developing strategies to revive our faltering ecosystem. With appearances by Laura Dern, Donald Glover, and Rosario Dawson.

2023-the-hi-de-ho-show.title: The Hi De Ho Show
2023-the-hi-de-ho-show.summary: Our host John Goddard explores the birth of rock’n’roll as he veejays an evening unpacking the marvels and mysteries, backstories and gossip of that mid-20th-century movement that changed the world forever.

2023-ote.title: Öte
2023-ote.summary: In this quietly beguiling film, a Black American woman traveling solo through Turkey forges unexpected connections as she explores the landscape.

2023-fingernails.title: Fingernails
2023-fingernails.summary: At the “Love Institute,” couples seek to reduce the risks of romance. Director Christos Nikou and a stellar cast (Jessie Buckley, Jeremy Allen White, Riz Ahmed) brilliantly craft a story-world that is both distant from our own yet almost too close for comfort.

2023-better-late-than-never.title: Better late than never
2023-better-late-than-never.summary: In skeletal stop-motion, two cousins at a Day of the Dead celebration impatiently await their Tia Carmen who is late with the food.

2023-i-m-hip.title: I'm Hip
2023-i-m-hip.summary: A self-absorbed cat, in a jazzy song and dance, proudly and comically proclaims his “hipness” to the world. The world is less convinced than he is.

2023-feast-your-ears-the-story-of-whfs-1.title: Feast Your Ears: The Story of WHFS 102.3 FM
2023-feast-your-ears-the-story-of-whfs-1.summary: This doc pays loving tribute to the culturally influential Maryland radio station whose progressive format reigned supreme from the '60s to the '80s, offering a vital alternative to Top 40 sameness.

2023-the-settlers.title: The Settlers
2023-the-settlers.summary: With a refreshingly modern sensibility, haunting cinematography, and an evocative score, Felipe Gálvez’s ambitious and expertly crafted debut charts the depredations visited on Indigenous people of Tierra del Fuego in 1901.

2023-founder-girls.title: Founder Girls
2023-founder-girls.summary: In this kaleidoscopic ode to girlhood, young campers find freedom, sisterhood, and themselves at a historically Black summer camp.

2023-national-anthem.title: National Anthem
2023-national-anthem.summary: This open-hearted story about a community of free-spirited queer rodeo performers is a southwestern ranch romance for the 21st century.

2023-gaby-s-hills.title: Gaby's Hills
2023-gaby-s-hills.summary: Puberty rears its head unexpectedly for one girl as she navigates relationships with male schoolmates.

2023-fallen-leaves.title: Fallen Leaves
2023-fallen-leaves.summary: Finnish writer-director Aki Kaurismäki reasserts himself as the master of the wry, melancholy comedy with this tale of two lonely souls forging a love connection in Helsinki.

2023-b-word.title: B Word
2023-b-word.summary: Maternal longings go viral within a woman’s social circle.

2023-shadowstalker.title: Shadowstalker
2023-shadowstalker.summary: Outlines the history of Predictive Policing, the dangers of identity theft which targets victims with a bias on race and economics, and the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement’s use of AI.

2023-the-pigeon-tunnel.title: The Pigeon Tunnel
2023-the-pigeon-tunnel.summary: Academy Award®-winner Errol Morris’ mesmerizing profile of novelist John le Carré gets personal and profound, revealing how his upbringing forged a great literary facility with the themes of falsehood, betrayal, and spycraft.

2023-fancy-dance.title: Fancy Dance
2023-fancy-dance.summary: Elements of the mystery and road movie genres combine in Erica Tremblay’s moving narrative debut, focusing on teenage Roki and her Aunt Jax as they search for Roki’s missing mother.

2023-gugu-nagogo.title: Gugu naGogo
2023-gugu-nagogo.summary: When a lunar eclipse interferes with their magical late-night letter exchanges, 12-year-old aspiring astronomer Gugu must find a new way to reconnect with her beloved grandmother.

2023-panel-state-of-the-industry.title: Panel: State of the Industry
2023-panel-state-of-the-industry.summary: In this brave new world, are theatrical distribution and exhibition worth saving? Are streamers really the golden cow the studios thought they'd be? MVFF Executive Director Mark Fishkin invites respected industry veterans to weigh in on pressing issues.

2023-skin-of-glass.title: Skin of Glass
2023-skin-of-glass.summary: When she learns that squatters occupy the now-dilapidated São Paulo skyscraper her late father designed, Bay Area documentarian Denise Zmekhol returns home to investigate – and make peace with her dad.

2023-day-of-the-fight.title: Day of the Fight
2023-day-of-the-fight.summary: Renowned actor Jack Huston’s extraordinary writing/directing debut is an exquisitely composed, understated portrait of a complicated former boxing champ coming to grips with his past.

2023-robot-dreams.title: Robot Dreams
2023-robot-dreams.summary: In a hand-drawn work of melancholy beauty, director Pablo Berger ( Blancanieves ) and Sara Varon adapt her graphic novel about the bond between a lonely canine and a robot in 1980s Manhattan.

2023-shorts-emma-lee.title: Shorts: Emma Lee
2023-shorts-emma-lee.summary: Women write and/or direct women-centered stories in this fun assembly of shorts.

2023-panel-forging-paths-navigating-the-.title: PANEL: Forging Paths: Navigating the U.S. Film Market for Independent Latin American Filmmakers
2023-panel-forging-paths-navigating-the-.summary: Navigating the U.S. Film Market for Independent Latin American Filmmakers

2023-a-double-life.title: A Double Life
2023-a-double-life.summary: Filled with the radical political fervor of his times, lawyer Stephen Bingham’s devotion to prison reform came at a high price.

2023-anatomy-of-a-fall.title: Anatomy of a Fall
2023-anatomy-of-a-fall.summary: French director Justine Triet’s gripping procedural mixes marriage story and courtroom drama, with Sandra Hüller as an enigmatic writer whose husband (Swann Arlaud) died — either by suicide or murder.

2023-an-ordinary-day.title: An Ordinary Day
2023-an-ordinary-day.summary: Two female friends — one blind, the other in a wheelchair — find that time they decided to spend together is anything but ordinary.

2023-how-to-live-100-years-or-more.title: How To Live 100 Years (or more)
2023-how-to-live-100-years-or-more.summary: A contemplation of longevity. A wordless video essay. A cinematic collaboration between documentary film maker Gary Weimberg (2-time Emmy award winner, 6-time Emmy nominee) and sound designer Gary Rydstrom (7-time Oscar winner, 20-time nominee).

2023-logic-paralyzes-the-heart.title: Logic Paralyzes the Heart
2023-logic-paralyzes-the-heart.summary: This is the story of the first cyborg, portrayed by actress Joan Chen, who details the history of cyborgian technology from its early intention as a tool for human liberation to the break between ethical human advancement and exploitation.

2023-panel-accessibility-in-exhibition-t.title: Panel: Accessibility in Exhibition: Take Action with Resources
2023-panel-accessibility-in-exhibition-t.summary: Join Cassidy Dimon (Director of Programs, Events & Accessibility - Full Spectrum Features and FEAW (Film Event Accessibility Working Group)) in a pre-recorded discussion regarding the resources one can find and utilize to create accessible event spaces and engage with our disabled communities.

2023-shorts-you-got-to-run.title: Shorts: You Got to Run
2023-shorts-you-got-to-run.summary: Kindred spirits find joy, comfort, and support in these short films that celebrate friendships, both new and seasoned, in lovely detail.

2023-mountains.title: Mountains
2023-mountains.summary: Monica Sorelle’s breathtaking first feature unfolds as a hypnotic slow burn of one family’s struggles, focusing on a Haitian demolition worker watching the gentrification of his Miami neighborhood.

2023-take-me-home.title: Take Me Home
2023-take-me-home.summary: Two sisters to confront the reality of a major change in their lives.

2023-rustin.title: Rustin
2023-rustin.summary: Colman Domingo’s ( If Beale Street Could Talk, MVFF41) fully inhabits this rousing and intimate portrait of gay Civil Rights leader Bayard Rustin, focused on his activism in the weeks leading up to the historic 1963 March on Washington.

2023-room.title: Room
2023-room.summary: Struggling with depression and social anxiety, a teen locks himself in his imaginary room as his life plays out around him. Told through remarkable miniatures, the film follows his post-pandemic journey as he tries to escape from his psychological lockdown.

2023-terrestrial-verses.title: Terrestrial Verses
2023-terrestrial-verses.summary: Spare, vivid, and, above all, humane, this series of satirical vignettes set in Tehran depicts the quiet courage it takes to negotiate the everyday absurdities of totalitarianism.

2023-shorts-youth-works.title: Shorts: Youth Works
2023-shorts-youth-works.summary: This year’s collection of peer-reviewed, youth-produced short films presents an inspiring display of emerging young talent from as close to home as San Rafael and San Francisco and as far afield as Australia, Belgium, and Belarus.

2023-summer-solstice.title: Summer Solstice
2023-summer-solstice.summary: Bobbi Salvör Menuez is luminous as Leo, a young trans man weekending in the countryside with Eleanor, his cis straight crush from college. Their seemingly carefree youth collides with the realities of adulting, forcing big questions.

2023-avenue-of-the-giants.title: Avenue of the Giants
2023-avenue-of-the-giants.summary: Bay Area filmmaker Finn Taylor movingly dramatizes the true story of Auschwitz survivor Herbert Heller (Stephen Lang), who kept his past a secret for more than 50 years — until the unexpected friendship of a troubled teenager (Elsie Fisher) made hope and healing possible.

2023-no-more-longing.title: No More Longing
2023-no-more-longing.summary: From Brazil to California and four years after starting testosterone, Jaime Jobim searches for his new voice.

2023-cleo-nina.title: Cleo & Nina
2023-cleo-nina.summary: This animated documentary brings to life a phone call between five-year-old Sara and her grandmother Nina with a story about Nina’s childhood pet pig and an itchy dress.

2023-seaweed.title: Seaweed
2023-seaweed.summary: A chance encounter between an Israeli boy and a mysterious stranger yields something special.

2023-a-life-in-technicolor.title: A Life in Technicolor
2023-a-life-in-technicolor.summary: Alone in her apartment during the pandemic, Natalie turns to her favorite classic movies to keep her company.

2023-the-promised-land.title: The Promised Land
2023-the-promised-land.summary: It’s 1755 and Captain Ludvig Kahlen (Mads Mikkelsen) seeks to establish a settlement in the name of the Danish King. His sole reward: a royal title for himself. Mikkelsen has never been “Madder” than in this sweepingly cinematic must-see modern classic.

2023-eat-flowers.title: Eat Flowers
2023-eat-flowers.summary: When photographer and writer Cig Harvey discovers her best friend has leukemia, she sets out to fill her world with color and light.

2023-water-for-life.title: Water For Life
2023-water-for-life.summary: Documentarian Will Parrinello gets astonishingly close as he captures the efforts of three environmental defenders in Chile, El Salvador, and Honduras, all fighting for clean water.

2023-immortality.title: Immortality
2023-immortality.summary: Written and performed by a Cyborg – a GPT-3 Chatbot, considers how to transform human discrimination and technological weapons into tools of survival.

2023-place-setting.title: Place Setting
2023-place-setting.summary: An immersion into the exquisite tactility of housekeeping finds expression and rebellion.

2023-the-lake-merritt-monster.title: The Lake Merritt Monster
2023-the-lake-merritt-monster.summary: When Ollie’s mother is attacked by a monster hiding in the depths of Lake Merritt, he sets out on a mission to find her—discovering instead a hidden network of monster-hunters tasked with protecting Oakland from its own dark underbelly.

2023-mustache.title: Mustache
2023-mustache.summary: With a solid ensemble including Alicia Silverstone, Hasan Minhaj, and Rizwan Manji, this heartfelt comedy offers a look at the Pakistani-American immigrant experience in 1990s Silicon Valley.

2023-american-fiction.title: American Fiction
2023-american-fiction.summary: Writer Cord Jefferson ( The Good Place ) proves himself a director to watch with this impressive adaptation of Percival Everett’s Erasure , starring Jeffrey Wright.

2023-pripyat-horse.title: Pripyat Horse
2023-pripyat-horse.summary: Sally Patrica Pearce shares a moment of mourning — for a friend, and for the Earth.

2023-cyborgian-rhapsody.title: Cyborgian Rhapsody
2023-cyborgian-rhapsody.summary: A long fascination with AI—its potentials, uses, and abuses—is at the heart of visionary San Francisco artist and filmmaker Lynn Hershman Leeson’s four short films under the collective title Cyborgian Rhapsody , featuring performances by Tessa Thompson ( Passing , MVFF44) and Joan Chen ( Lust, Caution , MVFF32).

2023-tracing-history.title: Tracing History
2023-tracing-history.summary: A Chinese-American filmmaker and her mother contemplate loss and legacy while visiting sites where their Chinese ancestors labored.

2023-starling.title: Starling
2023-starling.summary: A heavenly body finds itself on an Earth-bound trajectory.

2023-seduction-of-a-cyborg.title: Seduction of a Cyborg
2023-seduction-of-a-cyborg.summary: A poetic metaphor about the invasion of technology into an unsuspecting body, causing vision loss.

2023-milli-vanilli.title: Milli Vanilli
2023-milli-vanilli.summary: This deep-dive documentary corrects the record on the sensational ’80s pop duo done in by a rapacious music industry.

2023-mist.title: Mist
2023-mist.summary: When Nicolas and his family move from the city to a new house next to a forest, his perception starts to change thanks to mysterious encounters with native animals.

2023-the-lampboy-or-the-universe-between.title: The Lampboy, or The Universe Between Us
2023-the-lampboy-or-the-universe-between.original_title: Der Lampenjunge, oder Das Universum zwischen uns
2023-the-lampboy-or-the-universe-between.summary: A woman experiences a sexual reawakening when she finds herself in a surprise hookup.

2023-a-conversation-in-passing.title: A Conversation in Passing
2023-a-conversation-in-passing.summary: Two strangers find themselves in a surreal chat.

2023-chasin-butterflies.title: Chasin' Butterflies
2023-chasin-butterflies.summary: Filmmakers Joshua Harding, Adam Hobbs, and Matt Klug introduce us to an unforgettable, eccentric, playful, provocative, self-taught artist from rural Alabama.

2023-priscilla.title: Priscilla
2023-priscilla.summary: Director Sofia Coppola’s exquisite gift for depicting the complex psychology of young women is in ample evidence in this superb star-crossed love story. Based on Priscilla Presley’s best-selling memoir.

2023-goose-town.title: Goose Town
2023-goose-town.summary: An urban teenager finds solace from his chaotic home life in a fictional cowboy outlaw persona, but risks taking the cosplay one step too far.

2023-masterclass-on-animation-with-john-.title: Masterclass: On Animation with John Musker
2023-masterclass-on-animation-with-john-.summary: Join legendary animator, screenwriter, director, and producer John Musker ( Aladdin , The Little Mermaid , Moana )_ _as he gives an inside look into the process of his newest venture, the independently made short, I'm Hip .

2023-radical.title: Radical
2023-radical.summary: This audience favorite from Sundance 2023 dramatizes how a schoolteacher in Mexico threw out the rule book so his sixth-graders could see their true potential.

2023-kidnapped.title: Kidnapped
2023-kidnapped.summary: Marco Bellocchio’s historical drama portrays the true story of Edgardo Mortara, a Jewish boy baptized in 1857 Bologna and taken from his family by the Papal States.

2023-the-innocent-bystander.title: The Innocent Bystander
2023-the-innocent-bystander.summary: Sally Eckhoff's animation pays affectionate tribute to the late San Francisco musician Dan Hicks.

2023-they-shot-the-piano-player.title: They Shot the Piano Player
2023-they-shot-the-piano-player.summary: A New York music journalist (voiced by Jeff Goldblum) investigates the 1976 disappearance of Brazilian piano virtuoso Francisco Tenório Júnior. The sounds of bossa nova, delivered by the era’s musical luminaries, bring Tenório's intriguing story to vivid life.

2023-dance-with-me.title: Dance With Me
2023-dance-with-me.summary: Imagine putting on a blindfold on a busy Berkeley street corner and inviting strangers to dance with you. That’s what Gabriel Diamond did.

2023-the-fortunate-ones.title: The Fortunate Ones
2023-the-fortunate-ones.summary: Surprises are afoot in Swiss director Jeanne Waltz’s flavorful drama set in Portugal’s southernmost Algarve region, where an impulsive young woman scandalizes her neglectful wealthy family with an interracial romance.

2023-gone-before-your-eyes.title: Gone Before Your Eyes
2023-gone-before-your-eyes.summary: An artist finds herself in a disorienting painting session.

2023-strawberry-picker.title: Strawberry Picker
2023-strawberry-picker.summary: San Francisco printmaker and social activist Juan R. Fuentes reflects on generations of struggle and resilience in the Chicano art community.

2023-the-dance.title: The Dance
2023-the-dance.summary: Andrés gets invited to the school dance by the girl he likes, but there's one problem: His shoe has a hole in it. With only a day left, Andrés must find a way to fix his shoe and impress his crush.

2023-education-workshop-mindfulness-in-t.title: Education Workshop: Mindfulness in the Classroom
2023-education-workshop-mindfulness-in-t.summary: FOLLOWING THE FRIDAY, OCT. 13 SCREENING: W. Kamau Bell in conversation with Ericka Huggins and ShakaJamal.

2023-panel-balancing-act-virtual-product.title: Panel: Balancing Act: Virtual Production Technology in the Creative Process
2023-panel-balancing-act-virtual-product.summary: Whether you're a director, producer, or a curious cinephile, this panel encourages thoughtful consideration of VP's role in enhancing a narrative story. Join us for a practical journey into VP's world of possibilities.

2023-shorts-it-s-my-way.title: Shorts: It's My Way
2023-shorts-it-s-my-way.summary: This documentary shorts program with strong Bay Area ties follows exceptional individuals bravely delving into their roots.

2023-all-happy-families.title: All Happy Families
2023-all-happy-families.summary: A deeply relatable portrait of family dysfunction in which two competitive brothers reunite in their childhood home for one eventful weekend, revealing secrets and airing out long-held resentments.

2023-may-december.title: May December
2023-may-december.summary: A battle of wills develops between an actress (Natalie Portman) and the controversial woman (Julianne Moore) she’s been hired to portray. Under the keen eye of director Todd Haynes (Tribute, MVFF40), family secrets are revealed, surprise motivations surfaced, and our expectations upended.

2023-river-of-desire.title: River of Desire
2023-river-of-desire.summary: Lushly set in the Brazilian Amazon, acclaimed writer-director Sérgio Machado’s sultry drama follows three brothers entangled in a thorny co-habitation with the middle sibling’s new wife.

2023-yesterday-again.title: Yesterday, Again
2023-yesterday-again.summary: In CG animation, a former pilot reflects on his past and how his memories shape his choices.

2023-monster.title: Monster
2023-monster.summary: This Rashomon -like drama explores a troubling school incident from multiple perspectives. Shoplifters (MVFF41) director Hirokazu Kore-eda presents a study of bullying and youthful yearning, showing how confusing life can be to both adults and children.

2023-shorts-eventually.title: Shorts: Eventually
2023-shorts-eventually.summary: In this shorts program, we present a collection of true-life tales about extraordinary individuals from around the world.

2023-the-holdovers.title: The Holdovers
2023-the-holdovers.summary: Alexander Payne’s moving and funny latest is set in 1971 at an elite boarding school, where curmudgeonly Professor Hunham (a terrific Paul Giamatti) has the responsibility of staying on campus over winter break to supervise those few kids unable to go home for the holidays.

2023-rosa-and-the-stone-troll.title: Rosa and the Stone Troll
2023-rosa-and-the-stone-troll.summary: Rosa, a timid flower fairy, befriends Silk, a fearless butterfly. When a Stone Troll kidnaps Silk, Rosa must find the courage to save her. With friendship as her guiding light, Rosa learns to open her heart.

2023-the-zone-of-interest.title: The Zone of Interest
2023-the-zone-of-interest.summary: Adapting the Martin Amis novel, Under the Skin filmmaker Jonathan Glazer finds a startling new way to depict the Holocaust: through the blinkered perspective of the monsters who orchestrated it.

2023-fast-charlie.title: Fast Charlie
2023-fast-charlie.summary: The Deep South gets hot indeed as veteran hitman Pierce Brosnan finds himself in the middle of an organized-crime turf war. This backroads noir provides a rogue’s gallery of colorful figures including James Caan in one of his final roles.

2024-the-next-wave-mind-the-gap-filmmake.title: THE NEXT WAVE: MIND THE GAP FILMMAKER ROUNDTABLE
2024-the-next-wave-mind-the-gap-filmmake.summary: Celebrating the next wave of exceptional female and nonbinary filmmakers!

2024-wouldn-t-make-it-any-other-way.title: Wouldn't Make It Any Other Way
2024-wouldn-t-make-it-any-other-way.summary: From Iowa to Guam, an aspiring costume designer visits their homeland to make costumes for a children’s theater and reconnect with distanced parents.

2024-the-door.title: The Door
2024-the-door.summary: In Alexander Seltzer's film, a grieving couple find a bizarre portal when they deal with loss.

2024-the-social-chameleon.title: The Social Chameleon
2024-the-social-chameleon.summary: An inspiring story about finding your true colors.

2024-why-the-cattle-wait.title: Why The Cattle Wait
2024-why-the-cattle-wait.summary: The intimate tale of a goddess who tries to win back the affection of her former lover who has moved on in life without her.

2024-something-borrowed-something-pink.title: Something Borrowed, Something Pink
2024-something-borrowed-something-pink.summary: An old flame and trans friend discover that the road to identity can be beautifully fluid.

2024-the-bird-rescue-center.title: The Bird Rescue Center
2024-the-bird-rescue-center.summary: A cinematic window into the world of a California bird rescue sanctuary and the people who give wildlife a second chance.

2024-the-last-supper.title: The Last Supper
2024-the-last-supper.summary: Hell breaks loose when Betty’s narcissistic grandmother and obnoxious older sister come home for a family dinner.

2024-meet-me-at-the-creek.title: ᏗᏂᏠᎯ ᎤᏪᏯ (Meet Me at the Creek)
2024-meet-me-at-the-creek.summary: A Cherokee Nation citizen, a Waterkeeper Warrior, leads the effort to restore Oklahoma’s Tar Creek.

2024-like-a-stone-or-flower.title: Like a Stone or Flower
2024-like-a-stone-or-flower.summary: Three artists of different generations reflect on the ability of art to transcend rationality and logic.

2024-everything-will-be-ok-again.title: Everything Will Be OK Again
2024-everything-will-be-ok-again.summary: A mother must come to terms with her son's character when he unexpectedly makes the local news.

2024-the-callback.title: The Callback
2024-the-callback.summary: An ambitious actress finds her way, and herself, on the road to building a character.

2024-lil-red-is-riding-the-wrong-way-in-.title: Lil Red is Riding the Wrong Way in the Hood
2024-lil-red-is-riding-the-wrong-way-in-.summary: Lil' Red is Riding the Wrong Way in the Hood is a hip hop and gender twist on a classic cautionary tale.

2024-there-will-be-hurt.title: There Will Be Hurt
2024-there-will-be-hurt.summary: A mournful story about people sobered and haunted by their traumatic past, a story about lost souls fighting to come to terms with their shattered lives while exploring the compelling thematic triangle of revenge, redemption, and justice.

2024-out-of-the-dark-cal-calamia.title: Out of the Dark: Cal Calamia
2024-out-of-the-dark-cal-calamia.summary: An intimate look at the journey of professional athlete Cal Calamia, a transgender marathon runner who's advocating for inclusion in the running world.

2024-armand.title: Armand
2024-armand.summary: Two boys, their parents, and staff struggle for redemption after a mysterious incident at school in this drama that unveils secrets with chilling precision. A gripping exploration of parenthood, perception, and the unknown.

2024-checkpoint-zoo.title: Checkpoint Zoo
2024-checkpoint-zoo.summary: In the midst of Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, a volunteer team embarks on a mission to evacuate a zoo’s 5,000 creatures from the bombardment zone.

2024-shorts-time-to-come-home.title: Shorts: Time to Come Home
2024-shorts-time-to-come-home.summary: “Words can’t express what I feel inside of my flesh.” Whether they’re new partners or soulmates, these stories of love and attraction run the gamut of experiences both fresh and familiar.

2024-the-day-iceland-stood-still.title: The Day Iceland Stood Still
2024-the-day-iceland-stood-still.summary: A subversive, funny, and galvanizing documentary about the astonishing events of October 24, 1975, when 90% of Iceland’s women walked off their jobs. Vibrant interviews and color-soaked animation capture key moments and the real change that followed.

2024-red-boat-crossing-the-ship-that-tur.title: Red Boat Crossing/The Ship That Turned Back
2024-red-boat-crossing-the-ship-that-tur.summary: Bay Area directors create warmly emotional odes to family members’ WWII travails. Allie Light’s The Ship That Turned Back chronicles late spouse Irving Saraf’s childhood escape from occupied Poland; Jeanne C. Finley’s Red Boat Crossing recalls her mother’s dramatic Red Cross service.

2024-shorts-superpower.title: Shorts: Superpower
2024-shorts-superpower.summary: “When I’m standing in this mirror, after all these years, what I’m viewing is a little different.” These shorts immerse themselves, and the adventurous viewer, in entertaining flights of fancy.

2024-lost-in-time-druid-heights.title: Lost in Time: Druid Heights
2024-lost-in-time-druid-heights.summary: Crumbling Druid Heights, a once-thriving bohemian enclave near Mill Valley, could face the wrecking ball. Longtime resident Ed Stiles recalls a vibrant community and details its outsized influence on countless disparate 20th-century cultural movements.

2024-wild-diamond.title: Wild Diamond
2024-wild-diamond.summary: Nineteen-year-old Liane pursues fame as her escape from harsh reality, believing beauty is her power. Auditioning for a reality show, she chases validation, but the cost of being seen is steep in this gripping exploration of self-worth.

2024-nightbitch.title: Nightbitch
2024-nightbitch.summary: Marielle Heller’s ( Can You Ever Forgive Me? ) bold new film starring the impeccable Amy Adams explores the darker side of motherhood with humor and a dash of suspense.

2024-the-room-next-door.title: The Room Next Door
2024-the-room-next-door.summary: In Pedro Almodóvar’s first film in English, a formidable bond blossoms between two old friends (Tilda Swinton, Julianne Moore) who reconnect. Beautifully performed and visually striking, this masterful film explores how shared struggle can create a circuit of compassion

2024-conclave.title: Conclave
2024-conclave.summary: Cardinal Lawrence wants to resign but the Pope has just died and the Church’s future falls to him. Led by Ralph Fiennes’ brilliant turn as Father Lawrence, Conclave ’s stellar cast includes Stanley Tucci, John Lithgow, Lucian Msamati, and Isabella Rossellini.

2024-into-the-heart-of-the-mountain.title: Into the Heart of the Mountain
2024-into-the-heart-of-the-mountain.summary: Walk beside Zen Buddhist priest and social activist Roshi Joan Halifax on her path to empower women and indigenous people in this magnificent, emotionally bracing documentary.

2024-bird.title: Bird
2024-bird.summary: Barry Keoghan and Franz Rogowski costar in Andrea Arnold’s ( Fish Tank ) deft portrait of the burgeoning friendship between a wise-beyond-her-years tween and a free spirit named Bird.

2024-we-live-in-time.title: We Live in Time
2024-we-live-in-time.summary: Florence Pugh and Andrew Garfield prove great foils for each other as a chef (Pugh) and divorcé (Garfield) brought together by an accidental encounter. The seemingly unlikely match becomes a life-affirming journey that’s both defined by and transcends time.

2024-shorts-lovehappy-youth-works.title: Shorts: LoveHappy (Youth Works)
2024-shorts-lovehappy-youth-works.summary: This year’s collection of peer-reviewed, youth-produced short films showcases storytellers who are redefining humor in comedies, personal stories in documentaries, and murder in thrillers.

2024-2073.summary: Inspired by Chris Marker’s classic La Jetée, this experimental drama-documentary gives The Last of Us vibes mixed with the familiar horror of watching democracy and humanity imperiled daily.

2024-all-we-imagine-as-light.title: All We Imagine as Light
2024-all-we-imagine-as-light.summary: Crafted with visual poetry and empathy, MVFF Mind the Gap Award honoree Payal Kapadia’s drama shines a light on three nurses as they negotiate love and life in teeming Mumbai.

2024-american-cats-the-good-the-bad-and-.title: American Cats: The Good, the Bad, and the Cuddly
2024-american-cats-the-good-the-bad-and-.summary: Cats are dubbed “the quiet royalty of the living room” in this fond, furry portrait. But they’ve got a gripe...

2024-i-m-still-here.title: I'm Still Here
2024-i-m-still-here.summary: In 1970s Brazil, a family's life collapses when the military regime seizes former congressman Rubens Paiva. His wife, Eunice, becomes a fierce advocate for justice. Walter Salles directs this poignant film, which reveals the pain and resilience of fighting for truth.

2024-jesszilla.title: JessZilla
2024-jesszilla.summary: Jesselyn, 16, has a mischievous smile and the world’s best dad. Like him, she’s hooked on boxing. Director Emily Sheskin follows Jess on her road to the Junior Olympics, and her battle with the one opponent she’s unprepared to fight.

2024-better-man.title: Better Man
2024-better-man.summary: This exuberant, unconventional musical biopic of singer Robbie Williams blends extravagant song-and-dance sequences with a frank portrayal of the demons that accompanied his rise to worldwide acclaim.

2024-norah.title: Norah
2024-norah.summary: In this moving debut feature set in rural Saudi Arabia, a young woman rebels against laws condemning printed and drawn images. When she asks the new teacher to paint her portrait, tensions swirl memorably around and between them.

2024-memoir-of-a-snail.title: Memoir of a Snail
2024-memoir-of-a-snail.summary: Director Adam Elliot’s exquisitely eccentric snail-centered stop-motion family dramedy for adults is a basket of wonders, featuring voiceover talents of Australian luminaries Sarah Snook ( Succession ), Eric Bana ( Full Frontal ) and Kodi Smit-McPhee ( Power of the Dog ). Slimily sublime!

2024-blitz.title: Blitz
2024-blitz.summary: In Oscar® winner Steve McQueen's brilliant drama, a young boy sent to the country to wait out the WWII Blitz runs away, determined to make it back home to London.

2024-exhibiting-forgiveness.title: Exhibiting Forgiveness
2024-exhibiting-forgiveness.summary: Painter and sculptor Titus Kaphar brings his sense of wonder to the big screen with this affirming debut. The writer-director delivers a wrenching and deeply felt excavation of family, particularly the bonds that exist between fathers and sons.

2024-the-ship-that-turned-back.title: The Ship That Turned Back
2024-the-ship-that-turned-back.summary: Oscar® and Emmy winner Allie Light’s _The Ship That Turned Back _draws on a mix of elements in letting late husband/collaborator Irving Saraf recall his Jewish family’s harrowing flight from Nazi-occupied Poland.

2024-lunar-power.title: Lunar Power
2024-lunar-power.summary: Video game nut Miguel has a cheeky chat with his older, wiser Cousin Amaya. Miguel, un fanático de los videojuegos, tiene una charla descarada con su prima Amaya, que es mayor y más sabia.

2024-mind-the-gap-day-mvff47.title: Mind the Gap Day @MVFF47
2024-mind-the-gap-day-mvff47.summary: A celebration of female and nonbinary voices in filmmaking. The day’s festivities include a summit and networking lunch, film screenings, access to the filmmaker lounge, and a happy hour.

2024-bob-trevino-likes-it.title: Bob Trevino Likes It
2024-bob-trevino-likes-it.summary: While searching on Facebook for her estranged father, a young woman finds a man (John Leguizamo) with the same name, a caring father figure, who also could use a friend.

2024-the-black-sea.title: The Black Sea
2024-the-black-sea.summary: Aspiring rapper Khalid heads to Bulgaria for a gigolo gig he found on Facebook. Bay Area bigheartedness meets Brooklyn moxie in Crystal Moselle and Derrick B. Harden’s fish-out-of-water tale that’s refreshing as a cool drink on a hot summer day.

2024-gloria.title: Gloria!
2024-gloria.summary: The mysterious arrival of a piano at a Catholic shelter near Venice in the early 1800s sets progressive and orthodox musical outlooks ablaze in this rousing musical drama.

2024-mollie-s-pack.title: Mollie's Pack
2024-mollie-s-pack.summary: With newly recovered 16mm footage of the 1995 reintroduction of gray wolves to the American West and stories told by those who made it happen, this thrilling documentary offers an insider’s view of the animals’ return to their rightful rangelands.

2024-mistura.title: Mistura
2024-mistura.summary: This richly enjoyable mid-1960s period piece finds a Lima socialite at loose ends after her unfaithful husband’s departure. But she discovers more inner resources than anyone expects, forging a surprising new path of independence and culinary invention.

2024-zurawski-v-texas.title: Zurawski v Texas
2024-zurawski-v-texas.summary: This urgent documentary reveals the devastation inflicted on pregnant Texans, effectively barred from emergency obstetric care, due to the state’s draconian abortion ban. Women push back, engaging in an epic legal battle to clarify medical exemptions and save lives.

2024-mvff47-opening-night-gala.title: MVFF47 OPENING NIGHT GALA
2024-mvff47-opening-night-gala.summary: Join us in celebrating the Opening of the 47th Mill Valley Film Festival!

2024-familiar-touch-creative-aging-works.title: Familiar Touch & Creative Aging Workshop
2024-familiar-touch-creative-aging-works.summary: Join filmmaker Sarah Friedland ( Familiar Touch 2024) and lead actress Kathleen Ann Chalfant for a Creative Aging Workshop for older adults, care persons and their families. The filmmaking team will walk you through making your own short film.

2024-there-can-only-be-one.title: There Can Only Be One...
2024-there-can-only-be-one.summary: A chaotic battle ensues between a cat and a girlfriend in order to compete for the love and attention from the oblivious boyfriend.

2024-panel-state-of-the-industry.title: PANEL: STATE OF THE INDUSTRY
2024-panel-state-of-the-industry.summary: Audience enthusiasm energizes a resurgent independent film world

2024-the-chihuahua-shake.title: The Chihuahua Shake
2024-the-chihuahua-shake.summary: A musical comedy about a famous Parisian dachshund who is tasked with painting a portrait of a crazy chihuahua who just won't stop shaking.

2024-minus-daisy.title: Minus Daisy
2024-minus-daisy.summary: After his favorite stuffed animal, Daisy, is taken away by his dad, a young boy must go on a frightening nighttime journey throughout his house to get it back.

2024-dreamkeeping.title: Dreamkeeping
2024-dreamkeeping.summary: Dreams of a housekeeping room attendant come to life as she imagines what her future might hold.

2024-five-minutes-to-five-years.title: Five Minutes to Five Years
2024-five-minutes-to-five-years.summary: A familiar and banal space of a parking lot transforms into something unfamiliar and uncanny. What is usually the welcomed end of a day becomes a liminal space that exists somewhere between ‘before’ and ‘after.’

2024-forever-mine.title: Forever Mine
2024-forever-mine.summary: Reminiscing on the memory of a past relationship.

2024-guiding-light.title: Guiding Light
2024-guiding-light.summary: Thirty years after an infamous kidnapping, a teen growing up in the same town brings a fresh perspective and highlights the importance of the legacy of this case to the continuing endeavor to keep children safe.

2024-heaven-in-a-wild-flower.title: Heaven in a Wild Flower
2024-heaven-in-a-wild-flower.language: English, The film is non verbal (no spoken dialogue), but there are burnt in chapter titles in English.
2024-heaven-in-a-wild-flower.summary: In Heaven in a Wild Flower we immerse ourselves in a lyrical exploration of the perilous consequences of pesticides on bees and their intricate ecosystem. In a mesmerizing microscopic world, science meets artistry, fraught with danger and beauty.

2024-appa-tales-stories-from-my-grandfat.title: Appa Tales: Stories From My Grandfather
2024-appa-tales-stories-from-my-grandfat.summary: My grandfather recounts stories from his childhood when he was growing up during and after the Korean War.

2024-keep-it-open.title: Keep It Open
2024-keep-it-open.summary: A queer couple is tested when a mystery man comes to town.

2024-this-is-a-story-without-a-plan.title: This Is a Story Without a Plan
2024-this-is-a-story-without-a-plan.summary: Beautifully surreal landscape is the entrancing hook to the animated This is a Story without a Plan.

2024-shorts-sweet-dreams.title: Shorts: Sweet Dreams
2024-shorts-sweet-dreams.summary: “Can you hold my hands and be my guide? Clouds filled with stars cover your skies.” This documentary shorts program reflects on the value of intergenerational community, love, and activism.

2024-brief-history-of-a-family.title: Brief History of a Family
2024-brief-history-of-a-family.summary: With shades of Joseph Losey’s The Servant and Bong Joon-ho’s Parasite in his scintillating directorial debut, Jianjie Lin invites us into a middle-class household in Beijing

2024-standing-above-the-clouds.title: Standing Above the Clouds
2024-standing-above-the-clouds.summary: Up above the clouds, on the highest mountain from the seafloor, a group of native Hawaiian women fight to defend the sacred mountain of Mauna Kea from the world’s largest telescope.

2024-dahomey.title: Dahomey
2024-dahomey.summary: Brimming with insight, French-Senegalese filmmaker Mati Diop’s imaginative and pointed hybrid documentary depicts the story of 26 antiquities returned to Benin by France, the country’s former colonizer.

2024-pimpinero-blood-and-oil.title: Pimpinero: Blood and Oil
2024-pimpinero-blood-and-oil.summary: In Andrés Baiz’s drama, a young smuggler's world unravels amidst a deadly rivalry on the Colombia-Venezuela border. With gripping performances and stunning visuals, this electrifying thriller explores betrayal, greed, and survival in a lawless land.

2024-good-men.title: Good Men
2024-good-men.summary: Filmmaker Bobby Roth embarks on a thought-provoking journey seeking candid answers to questions on masculinity, femininity, and whether we have the power to change.

2024-the-legend-in-me.title: The Legend In Me
2024-the-legend-in-me.summary: A 20th-century Canadian sports legend, Lionel Conacher begat a line of other star-athlete descendants. But in this simultaneously nostalgic and forward-looking documentary, their 21st-century progeny explores the very different fields of non-binary queer identity.

2024-everybody-loves-touda.title: Everybody Loves Touda
2024-everybody-loves-touda.summary: A woman (a dazzling Nisrin Erradi) pursues her dream of becoming a singer of traditional Aita with the same fierceness as the Bedouins who came before her, facing her modern-day obstacles with an exuberance equaled by her songs.

2024-fools-paradise-lost.title: Fools' Paradise (lost?)
2024-fools-paradise-lost.summary: An ailing planet is very much tied to human beings’ own ills, physical and psychological. Filmmaker Alexandra Lexton’s scenic documentary probes that connection via the stories of individuals from her own backyard to the Tanzanian outback.

2024-milonga.title: Milonga
2024-milonga.summary: Middle-aged widow Rosa lives a quiet life dominated by the ghosts of her long ago marriage. As she makes a new life for herself, jarring revelations force her to face facts about her past and who she is today.

2024-thelma-s-perfect-birthday.title: Thelma's Perfect Birthday
2024-thelma-s-perfect-birthday.summary: Thelma, an adventuresome penguin, is four and soon she’ll turn five – she hopes. What if she’s not home when her Birthday arrives? Reinis Kalnaellis brings to life a beautifully animated tale of self-acceptance, friendship and the meaning of growing up.

2024-anora.title: Anora
2024-anora.language: English, English and Russian with English subtitles
2024-anora.summary: MVFF47 honoree Mikey Madison’s breakthrough performance as a sex worker who impulsively marries a Russian oligarch’s son powers Sean Baker’s latest indie marvel, Cannes’ Palme d’Or winner.

2024-waves.title: Waves
2024-waves.summary: Set during the heady days of the 1968 Prague Spring and the subsequent Warsaw Pact invasion of Czechoslovakia, this thriller blending fact and fiction is a gripping ode to press freedom and a timely reminder of the dangers of censorship.

2024-to-kill-a-wolf.title: To Kill A Wolf
2024-to-kill-a-wolf.summary: Stunning shots of a forest and a haunting soundtrack set the stage for this contemporary riff on Little Red Riding Hood. First-time feature writer-director Kelsey Taylor explores what might have inspired the original fairy tale.

2024-bay-area-community-mixer-the-future.title: BAY AREA COMMUNITY MIXER: THE FUTURE OF FILMMAKING IN THE BAY AREA
2024-bay-area-community-mixer-the-future.summary: Join us for an afternoon of connection and conversation with filmmakers and film lovers from across the Bay Area!

2024-queer.title: Queer
2024-queer.summary: Daniel Craig ( Glass Onion , MVFF45) is magnificent in Luca Guadagnino’s audacious, erotic, hallucinogenic take on Beat legend William S. Burroughs’ autobiographical novel set on the seedy side of 1950s Mexico City.

2024-ahkuin.title: ÁHKUIN
2024-ahkuin.summary: Three generations of women in a Sámi family have connected over time through practicing joik —a Sámi oral tradition that combines music and storytelling.

2024-bickering.title: Bickering
2024-bickering.summary: Best friends Harriet and Priscilla argue over a small misunderstanding.

2024-the-alien.title: The Alien
2024-the-alien.summary: 17-year-old Jesse tries his best to avoid going to a New Year's Eve party, as many obstacles get in his way.

2024-sunchong.title: Sunchong
2024-sunchong.summary: An 89-year-old Korean immigrant who volunteers at a senior center reflects on his life’s journey with his beloved wife.

2024-the-crow-and-the-squirrel.title: The Crow and the Squirrel
2024-the-crow-and-the-squirrel.summary: The Crow and the Squirrel provides a beautiful lesson in communication and compassion. “El cuervo y la ardilla” ofrece una hermosa lección de comunicación y compasión.

2024-the-anchor-and-the-kite.title: The Anchor and the Kite
2024-the-anchor-and-the-kite.summary: The Anchor is bound to the ground by the weight of his cumbersome existence. The Kite is vibrant and brave but has little control over her path in life. A glimmer in the distance leads to a life-changing encounter between the two.

2024-the-captives.title: The Captives
2024-the-captives.summary: When her mother gives Jolie an ultimatum, she is suddenly forced to face who she is and who she ultimately wants to become.

2024-the-curtains-glow-at-night.title: The Curtains Glow At Night
2024-the-curtains-glow-at-night.summary: When Wren comes home from college, they discover a ghost in their childhood bedroom.

2024-llamas-at-the-laundromat.title: Llamas at the Laundromat
2024-llamas-at-the-laundromat.summary: Martha Grant’s Llamas at the Laundromat is a delightful musical starring dancing llamas in fashionable attire.

2024-tayal-forest-club.title: Tayal Forest Club
2024-tayal-forest-club.summary: Through the help of their ancestor, two Atayal teens manage to find not only their way home but also themselves.

2024-knead.title: Knead
2024-knead.summary: The arrival of aliens dovetails nicely with a dissatisfied wife's wishes.

2024-ma-aye-ka-masaala-a-se-ka-wmti-from.title: Ma ŋaye ka Masaala a se ka Wɔmɛti (From God to Man)
2024-ma-aye-ka-masaala-a-se-ka-wmti-from.summary: Filmmaker Lansana Mansaray documents his return home.

2024-crab-claw.title: Crab Claw
2024-crab-claw.summary: Crab Claw features an incredibly awkward marriage counseling session.

2024-we-ride-for-her.title: We Ride for Her
2024-we-ride-for-her.summary: An Indigenous women’s motorcycle group rides to end the crisis of Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women while a member of their community searches for a missing sister.

2024-sole-sista.title: Sole Sista
2024-sole-sista.summary: Chelsea navigates the feeling of being different as the only black girl in school.

2024-mother.title: Mother
2024-mother.summary: There hasn't been a lesbian bar in San Francisco for almost a decade. Malia Spanyol, a self-identified dyke, sets out to build one for the next generation of women and femmes.

2024-democracy-noir.title: Democracy Noir
2024-democracy-noir.summary: A political thriller, character drama, and clarion call to action, this riveting documentary portraying resistance to Hungary’s authoritarian ruler Viktor Orbán is perfectly relevant for this political moment.

2024-the-piano-lesson.title: The Piano Lesson
2024-the-piano-lesson.summary: John David Washington and Danielle Deadwyler deliver striking performances as a Depression-era brother and sister fighting over what is to become of their family’s heirloom piano in Malcolm Washington’s memorable directing debut, a searing adaptation of August Wilson’s play,

2024-griffin-in-summer.title: Griffin In Summer
2024-griffin-in-summer.summary: Summer. Suburbia. Everyone is out having fun…except our 14-year-old hero, who in his pretentious precocity aims to write and stage the Great American Stage Drama. Even he gets distracted, however, once mom hires a hunky young handyman.

2024-windcatcher.title: Windcatcher
2024-windcatcher.summary: Percy Boy may be the fastest runner in school, but he’s always late to class. The Aboriginal boy has few allies except new kid Keithy, and Daisy, the scariest girl around. Tanith Glynn-Maloney’s debut feature celebrates family, friendship, and heritage.

2024-eastern-western.title: Eastern Western
2024-eastern-western.summary: A beautifully understated story of a son raised by two fathers, one from the European East and one the American West. Co-directors Biliana and Marina Grozdanova command the mise-en-scene with effortless elegance, in a resonant tale of friendship and resolve.

2024-my-dead-friend-zoe.title: My Dead Friend Zoe
2024-my-dead-friend-zoe.summary: A former US Army mechanic with PTSD (Sonequa Martin-Green) has a most unusual “best friend”—her late colleague (Natalie Morales) from a tour in Afghanistan, still a motor-mouthed constant companion despite the inconvenience of death.

2024-oceania-journey-to-the-center.title: Oceania: Journey to the Center
2024-oceania-journey-to-the-center.summary: The brutal impact of climate change drives Bay Area filmmaker Natalie Zimmerman's intense documentary. Focused on the Pacific Island nation of Kiribati, the film weaves breathtaking natural footage with the struggles of people navigating an environment that is slipping away.

2024-billy-preston-thats-the-way-god-pla.title: Billy Preston: That’s The Way God Planned It
2024-billy-preston-thats-the-way-god-pla.summary: This riveting documentary examines Billy Preston’s extraordinary career and life and pays soulful homage to the musical genius who blazed through the 1960s-‘70s music scene like a supernova.

2024-saturday-night.title: Saturday Night
2024-saturday-night.summary: 10pm. If Lorne Michaels can’t pull everything together by 11:30pm, his career ends before it’s begun. Jason Reitman delivers a delirious vision of the moments leading up to Chevy Chase’s first proclamation, “Live from New York, it’s Saturday Night!”

2024-malu.title: Malu
2024-malu.summary: A former actress battles her troubled past, strained family ties, and lingering scars from Brazil's political turmoil. This powerful drama, rich in emotion and resilience, offers a raw and moving portrait of three women bound by generational trauma.

2024-bring-them-home-aiskotahkapiyaaya.title: Bring Them Home/Aiskótáhkapiyaaya
2024-bring-them-home-aiskotahkapiyaaya.summary: Buffalo ruled the Great Plains, until hunted to near-extinction—simultaneously imperiling Native Americans who depended on them. Now Blackfoot tribes are working to return these animals to the wild.

2024-shorts-saturday-morning-cartoons.title: Shorts: Saturday Morning Cartoons
2024-shorts-saturday-morning-cartoons.summary: Who says watching Saturday morning cartoons with the family ended with the 20th century? Not us! Join us for this fun frenzy of animated wonders for kids of all ages, presented in collaboration with the Poppy Jasper International Film Festival.

2024-shorts-ring-the-alarm.title: Shorts: Ring the Alarm
2024-shorts-ring-the-alarm.summary: "Tell me how should I feel when I know what I know." This international collection is a vivid exploration of families who are confronted with some very harsh truths.

2024-on-becoming-a-guinea-fowl.title: On Becoming A Guinea Fowl
2024-on-becoming-a-guinea-fowl.summary: A woman discovers the corpse of her uncle, a man who caused her considerable pain, in this darkly funny portrait of Zambia’s matriarchal society that grippingly explores the younger generation’s desire to break free from the sins of the past.

2024-the-true-story-of-tamara-de-lempick.title: The True Story of Tamara De Lempicka & The Art of Survival
2024-the-true-story-of-tamara-de-lempick.summary: One of the defining artists of the 20th century, Tamara de Lempicka was a working mother, feminist, style icon, and bisexual libertine, who embodied Art Deco’s spirit and portrayed women in boldly erotic terms that broke the male gaze.

2024-homegrown.title: Homegrown
2024-homegrown.summary: Filmmaker Michael Premo follows three impassioned right-wing activists through the 2020 election, the January 6 Capitol riot, and beyond. With unexpected nuance and intimacy, he captures his protagonists’ combustible blend of delusional cosplayer, stalwart patriot, and potential threat.

2024-cheech-chong-s-last-movie.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
2024-cheech-chong-s-last-movie.summary: Chinese Canadian Tommy Chong and Mexican American Richard “Cheech” Marin relate the story of their decades-long partnership as one of the most successful comedy duos of all time.

2024-jude-law-tribute.title: Jude Law Tribute
2024-jude-law-tribute.summary: In the realm of cinema, few actors possess the captivating allure and versatile talent quite like Jude Law. This Tribute will revisit key moments from his remarkable and diverse career.

2024-tummy-tom-and-the-lost-teddy-bear.title: Tummy Tom and the Lost Teddy Bear
2024-tummy-tom-and-the-lost-teddy-bear.original_title: Dikkie Dik en de Verdwenen Knuffel
2024-tummy-tom-and-the-lost-teddy-bear.summary: Tummy Tom loves to curl up for catnaps with his favorite stuffed teddy. One day, he discovers…Bear is missing! Joost Van Den Bosch and Erik Verkerk’s sing-a-long animation is an interactive delight for kids age 2 to 200 (that’s cat-years).

2024-queens.title: Queens
2024-queens.summary: In 1992, amidst Lima’s political turmoil, two sisters and their mother prepare to flee Peru while their estranged father seeks reconciliation.Klaudia Reynicke’s poignant drama beautifully blends coming-of-age intimacy with powerful socio-political commentary.

2024-out-of-my-mind.title: Out of My Mind
2024-out-of-my-mind.summary: A sixth grader with cerebral palsy shows what she has to say is more important than how she says it.

2024-the-seed-of-the-sacred-fig.title: The Seed of The Sacred Fig
2024-the-seed-of-the-sacred-fig.summary: A seemingly honorable man gets promoted to investigating judge—a job that requires him to sign protesters’ death warrants—in this gripping thriller that brilliantly depicts how Iran’s oppressive regime obliterates the souls of its citizens.

2024-shorts-freedom.title: Shorts: Freedom
2024-shorts-freedom.summary: “I had my ups and downs, but I always find the inner strength to pull myself up.” In this shorts program, we present a collection of true-life tales about extraordinary individuals and cultural changemakers from around the world.

2024-mvff47-closing-night-party.title: MVFF47 CLOSING NIGHT PARTY
2024-mvff47-closing-night-party.summary: That's a wrap! A festive night to close out yet other amazing year of celebrating great cinema.

2024-red-boat-crossing.title: RED BOAT CROSSING
2024-red-boat-crossing.summary: An admiring tribute to quiet heroism that’s equal parts documentary and poetic reverie.

2024-four-nights-and-a-fire.title: Four Nights and a Fire
2024-four-nights-and-a-fire.summary: A young Ojibwe photographer stubbornly takes on the responsibility of keeping a sacred fire alive for four consecutive days and nights in mourning of his father. His father's spirit tries to reach him from the other side.

2024-panel-film-technology.title: PANEL: FILM TECHNOLOGY
2024-panel-film-technology.summary: Join us to explore how emerging technologies are transforming storytelling across film, television, experiential entertainment, and more.

2024-practical-rabbit-hunting-strategies.title: Practical Rabbit Hunting Strategies for the Modern Man
2024-practical-rabbit-hunting-strategies.summary: A boy hunts a rabbit on his 18th birthday in an attempt to understand what it means to grow up.

2024-sixteen.title: Sixteen
2024-sixteen.summary: When a Japanese American teenage girl is faced with the reality of being sent to conversion therapy, she has to choose herself or the community she was born into.

2024-we-would-be-freer.title: We Would Be Freer
2024-we-would-be-freer.summary: A reflection on the connection between colonization and nature through the use of sumac by a Palestinian refugee and a woman from the Mohawk community of Kahnawá:ke.

2024-not-my-name.title: Not My Name
2024-not-my-name.summary: When a well off Colombian family has to travel on a violent country road to visit their ailing grandfather, their reliance on their youngest child to conceal their fake identities will expose him to the reality of war.

2024-adventures-with-the-caretaker.title: Adventures with the Caretaker
2024-adventures-with-the-caretaker.summary: Adventures with the Caretaker features Bigfoot, the Loch Ness Monster, and the Abominable Snowman.

2024-think-too-much.title: Think Too Much
2024-think-too-much.summary: A musical journey through a landscape of broccoli.

2024-exuvia.title: Exuvia
2024-exuvia.summary: Being the object of attention yields some surprising responses for a young girl.

2024-alok.title: Alok
2024-alok.summary: This thought-provoking short documentary explores the limitless expression of self, challenges societal norms, and inspires viewers to embrace personal freedom beyond the binaries that divide us.

2024-paramita.title: Paramita
2024-paramita.summary: Part poetry, part memoir-style reflection, and part meditation, Paramita bears witness to Prajna Paramita Choudhury’s coming out process with her traditional Bangladeshi mother.

2024-your-monster.title: Your Monster
2024-your-monster.summary: Caroline Lindy’s delightful directorial feature debut spins a dark, whimsical beauty-and-the-beast tale of comedy, romance, and musical theater as a down-on-her-luck actress meets a real-life monster lurking in her childhood closet.

2024-the-order.title: The Order
2024-the-order.summary: MVFF47 honoree Jude Law delivers a resonant performance as an FBI agent battling Neo-Nazis in the Pacific Northwest in this fact-based, 1980s-set thriller where the suspense builds inexorably from its first frames to its stunning climax.

2024-hard-truths.title: Hard Truths
2024-hard-truths.summary: Nearly 30 years after Secrets & Lies , British auteur Mike Leigh reunites with Marianne Jean-Baptiste for this compelling drama. The actress delivers an indelible tour de force performance as an angry woman who takes out her frustrations on her family.

2024-emilia-perez.title: Emilia Pérez
2024-emilia-perez.summary: In Jacques Audiard’s vibrant crime thriller-meets-musical, a ruthless cartel boss transforms into Emilia Pérez, sparking a journey of identity and power. With an electrifying ensemble cast, this bold narrative redefines the gangster genre.

2024-active-cinema-hike.title: ACTIVE CINEMA HIKE
2024-active-cinema-hike.summary: Come and enjoy some fresh air and fresh ideas with filmmakers, friends, festival staff, and cinephiles during this hour-long hike to the ocean through beautiful terrain.

2024-the-book-of-jobs.title: The Book of Jobs
2024-the-book-of-jobs.summary: Kayci Lacob’s autobiographically inspired debut feature chronicles a Steve Jobs-worshiping Silicon Valley teen who discovers that a tech giant’s example doesn’t always provide a reliable roadmap to the problems of everyday suburban life.

2024-unstoppable.title: Unstoppable
2024-unstoppable.section: US Cinema, Special Screening, Big Nights
